items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mrs. Powell trusted me to go out with Bud when he had to go somewhere.

ctx.x: What was your interaction with Bud as it unfolded? Did you go over there frequently?

Oh man, every week. I was over there all the time. Mrs. Powell trusted me to go out with Bud when he had to go somewhere. She said, “Jackie, Bud’s got to go down to the Royal Roost tomorrow afternoon at 4 o’clock for two hours. Can you take him down there and bring him back?” I said, “Yeah, Mrs. Powell, I’ll take him.”
Is that because he needed someone to . . . ?
